newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks close higher, focus on retail.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks close higher, focus on retail.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended higher on Thursday on active buying of big-caps, while the focus on the retail sector after a business tycoon bought a stake in retailer Multipolar, brokers and analysts said.
The Jakarta composite index rose 4.78 points, or 0.75 percent, to close at 637.59 points. Advancers led decliners by 112 to 76 with 92 issues unchanged.
Totall turn-over was estimated at around 259 billion rupiah compared with 502 billion rupiah on Wednesday.

"Ramayana at the current PE of 19 times is still attractive. Its price could hit 6,200 rupiah against the closing price of 5,100 rupiah today as it is likely to post strong net profit growth this year," the retail analyst said.
The analyst attributed Ramayana's expected strong profit partly due to windfalls from recent changes in the tax system affecting the industry.
The most actively traded company, timber firm Barito Pacific, rose 100 rupiah to 2,050 rupiah near the close, but the reasons were not clear, brokers said.
